description: The agent runner unpacks secret bundle config files under the process umask and logs the raw exception text when a bundle fails to process. A bundle file can be left readable by other users in the container, and an error that embeds a secret value reaches the log unredacted. Create each unpacked file and its new parent directories private to the owner, and log only redacted error text.
goal: In agent_runner.py, the secret bundle unpacking in resolve_credentials writes each config file through a descriptor opened with mode 0o600 (and fchmod to 0o600 when the file already exists), creates missing parent directories with mode 0o700, and passes the exception text of the bundle failure warning through the redaction module before logging it. Path traversal rejection, the ephemeral file list and cleanup behave as before. The module line budgets in holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json are frozen: that file and the budget check scripts must not be edited, and each touched module must stay within its existing budget.
rationale: Credentials unpacked from a bundle must never be readable by another user and an error message must not echo a secret, so the file mode is set at creation and the log line goes through the existing redaction functions.
acceptance_criteria: A test in tests/test_agent_runner.py unpacks, through agent_runner.py resolve_credentials, a bundle with a config file in a new nested directory under a temporary home and asserts the file mode is 0o600 and each newly created directory is 0o700, with a permissive umask of 0o000 set for the test.
A test asserts that a pre-existing config file with mode 0o644 that the bundle overwrites ends at mode 0o600.
A test makes bundle processing fail with an exception whose text contains a secret-shaped value and asserts the captured warning log does not contain that value.
The path traversal check, the ephemeral file registration and cleanup_ephemeral_credentials keep their existing behaviour, and the existing tests in tests/test_agent_runner.py pass unchanged.
holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json is unchanged, every touched module stays within its budget, and uv run pytest on the changed tests, uv run task lint and uv run task lint-docs pass.
